headline:
Rates This Week: 7.28% Up,
7.33% Down
echo_q: One site says up, the other says down. Which one's right?
titan_answer: Both. The 7.28 percent is a weekly average of loan applications, up from the week before. The 7.33 percent is a daily read of lenders' rate sheets, down from Thursday. They count different things, so they can point different ways in the same week.
source: Freddie Mac, Nov 19, 2026 · Mortgage News Daily, Nov 20, 2026
disclaimer: General information, not a rate quote or a prediction. Your own rate depends on your credit, down payment and loan type; ask your lender.
